Meta.title: Elona Keybinds
Meta.author: Anon
Meta.description:
Classic Elona keybinds for Elin. Play with the keyboard instead of the mouse: e to eat, q to quaff, r to read, Z to zap, g to get, d to drop, w to wear, v to cast, o to open, p to pray, i to interact and more, with Elona-style selection menus. All keys rebindable in BepInEx/config/elin.elonakeys.cfg or by using modconfig gui.
I spent 2 weeks debugging and devving so I kinda gave up and pushed it out so I can get some real people testing and reporting bugs. There are just too many things to test and handle. If you find a bug, turn on debugging and reproduce it before sending me a log.
Still a lot of stuff to add/fix. Theming Container Settings, may be out of scope given Elona inventory Menu Nav
